author: releafed
body:
I am sorry _Kimmy for causing your ban. I know that nobody believed you. I was the one who was hacking, and I was the one who provoked FrostedCupcakez to ban you. It was a joke. I am very sorry to all the staff members involved in this. I am extremely sorry to you too, _Kimmy. It wasn't your fault, it was mine. To the staff reading this, I beg of you to unban my friend, Kimmy.

Thanks
